text:
Maya Patel: kicking off HALO POC perf thread. customer target = sustained 350 qps for 3-5 token replies but main risk is long-context retention (avg 2.5k tokens). they want comparative runs: fp16, ptq-int8, and awq-int8 + a mixed embed load. can we scope infra and test corpus?
Diego Ruiz: can run in dedicated us-west2 pool. need sample corpus (1k sessions) with long contexts + 10% embed-only calls. do they want prefix caching enabled?
Maya Patel: yes enable prefix caching to mimic prod. using anonymized support logs again — i'll drop the S3 link. also customer wants cost estimate per 1M prompt+completion tokens for each quant.
Riley Park: plan: 3m ramp, 25m steady @350 target, 5m soak @peak, 5m cooldown. capture p50/p95/p99, cold-start tail, kv cache hit, GPU mem spikes. will run 2x: one with cold cache, one warm.
OpsBot: deploy queued: cluster/dedicated/us-west2/slotset-7 image=redwood-runtime:2026-03-22-stable.
Elyse Tran: security note: HALO requested HSM-backed KMS and key zeroing proof. we'll need to include the security appendix and a named contact from infra.
Diego Ruiz: infra sizing: to keep headroom we recommend 10 slots (8 active + 2 spare) for the steady sweep. if multi-az failover required, that doubles infra and impacts pricing SLA.
Maya Patel: quality gate: include 50-case regression eval. flag any >4% accuracy drop or >3% hallucination increase vs fp16 baseline.
Riley Park: quick roughs before run: fp16 p95 ~ 190ms, ptq-int8 p95 ~ 210-230ms jitter, awq-int8 p95 ~ 170-185ms but watch p99 tails on cold. GPU util expected: fp16 ~60%, ptq ~48%, awq ~36%. cost ratio estimates: ptq ~0.6x, awq ~0.5x. will compute exact $/1M tokens post-run.
Maya Patel: also add a short note on fallback policy: if quant quality regresses on long contexts, propose canary to fp16 for >2k token sessions.
Diego Ruiz: running first sweep now (fp16 baseline). attaching run command: 
```
loadtest --corpus s3://redwood-poc/halo/sample-1k.json --target 350 --ramp 3m --steady 25m --model redwood/v1.2 --quant fp16 --cache-prefix --output /artifacts/halo/3922001110/fp16.csv
```
Riley Park: smoke done. fp16 run p95=186ms, p99=430ms (cold tails), kv hit 72%, GPU util avg 62%. exporting CSV to /artifacts/halo/3922001110/fp16.csv
Diego Ruiz: ptq-int8 sweep in progress.
OpsBot: run finished: /artifacts/halo/3922001110/ptq.csv status=success
Riley Park: ptq results: p95=215ms, p99=510ms, jitter on steady. kv hit 68%, GPU util 46%. noted some bandwidth reduction on embed-heavy sub-slice.
Diego Ruiz: awq-int8 sweep done. artifacts -> /artifacts/halo/3922001110/awq.csv
Riley Park: awq summary: p95=175ms, p99=480ms with a few spikes at 620ms on cold decode. kv hit 74%, GPU util 37%. eval 50-case diff vs fp16: 2 cases >4% accuracy drop, hallucination delta +1.1%.
Maya Patel: great. can you assemble a one-pager PDF with: bullets, heatmaps, CSVs, cost table per 1M tokens, and a short security appendix on KMS/HSM and key zeroing? target EOD.
Elyse Tran: noted. security appendix will mention HSM KMS support for Private and Dedicated, key zeroing on instance teardown, and link to SOC2 artifacts.
Riley Park: attaching CSVs and eval diff now: /artifacts/halo/3922001110/{fp16.csv,ptq.csv,awq.csv,eval_diff.csv}. sample cost calc used: instance_rate * tokens_processed / 1e6. final numbers will be in PDF.
Diego Ruiz: ops note: if customer wants multi-az failover, flag to sales — requires contract addendum and additional egress cost.
Maya Patel: thanks team. i'll send to HALO and propose awq-int8 + prefix caching + canary to fp16 for >2k token sessions. :thumbsup:
